## User request (French)
Completely **redo the Admin menu** — current one is not readable, practical, or pleasant. **Base the new Admin UI on the other menus** in the app (Dashboard home, Settings, Rewards, CategoryDetail, Layout) for visual and UX consistency.

## Before coding — study reference screens
Read these for design patterns (cards, sections, headings, spacing, buttons, colors):
- `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx`, `CategoryCard.tsx`, `DailyTasksSection.tsx`
- `src/pages/Settings.tsx`
- `src/pages/Rewards.tsx`, `Punishments.tsx`
- `src/components/Layout.tsx`, `src/index.css` (existing variables: --bg-card, --accent, section titles, `.page`, `.card`, etc.)

## Rebuild Admin (`src/pages/Admin.tsx` + CSS)

### Structure (match app style)
- Use same page wrapper as Settings/Dashboard: `.page` with clear `h2` section titles, subtitle hints
- **Top**: page title "Admin" + short description (like Settings)
- **Section navigation**: NOT cramped tiny tabs — use **large section cards/buttons** in a grid (like category cards on home) OR a clean **vertical sidebar on desktop / horizontal scroll chips on mobile** — pick what matches app best
  - Sections: Categories, Tasks, Rewards, Punishments, Users
- **One section visible at a time** OR single long scroll page with anchored sections — prefer **clear section switching** with big tap targets

### Per section layout (consistent with app)
- **List area**: use same card style as `TaskCard` / library items — rounded cards, spacing, meta line
- **Create form**: separate `.card` block below list (like Settings form groups), NOT cramped two-column phone panel
- **Full width** on admin route (keep `app-shell--admin-full`)
- **No `<select>` dropdowns** — chips/radios/scroll rows (user preference)
- Primary button style: same as rest of app (`btn-primary`)
- Delete: secondary danger, confirm dialog

### Functionality (must preserve)
- CRUD: categories, tasks, rewards, punishment templates, users
- Category image: CategoryImagePicker component
- resolvedCategoryId for tasks
- addCategory, addTask, addReward, addPunishmentTemplate, user management
- Search/filter where useful but styled as simple search input in card header

### Remove
- Old cramped `.admin-panel` two-column phone UX
- Overly complex admin-only components if they hurt clarity — simplify

### CSS
- Refactor admin styles in `index.css` — remove obsolete admin-* rules if replaced
- Reuse existing `.card`, `.section-title`, `.form-group` patterns from Settings where possible

### English only

Return: design decisions (what patterns copied from which page), files changed, screenshot-level description of new flow.

content.text:
## Design decisions

| Pattern | Source | Applied in Admin |
|--------|--------|------------------|
| Page shell | **Settings** | `.page` + `.page-header` with `h2` + `.muted` subtitle |
| Section headings | **Settings / Rewards** | `.section-title` for list blocks, form titles, and form sub-blocks |
| Form fields | **Settings** | `.field` labels, `.login-error` / `.notice` for feedback (replaces custom admin fields/banners) |
| Cards | **Dashboard / Settings** | `.card` for list area and create/edit form (stacked, full width) |
| List rows | **Rewards** (`reward-item`) + **TaskCard** meta line | `.admin-library` items with title + muted meta + Edit/Delete actions |
| Category navigation | **Dashboard** (`category-grid` / `category-card`) | Large `.admin-nav-card` buttons (icon, label, hint) — grid column on desktop, horizontal scroll on mobile |
| Chips / radios | **Home** chips + existing admin chip UX | Shared `.chip-row` / `.chip` and `.choice-list` / `.choice` (no `<select>`) |
| Full-width admin | **Layout** | `app-shell--admin-full` kept |

**Navigation choice:** Vertical sticky sidebar from **768px+**; horizontal scroll nav cards below **768px** (same pattern as `tabs--scroll` / category chips, but larger tap targets like category cards).

**Layout choice:** One section at a time with clear switching (not a long scroll). Each section is **list card → form card** vertically (removed cramped two-column `.admin-panel`).

---

## Files changed

- `src/pages/Admin.tsx` — full UI restructure; logic preserved (CRUD, `resolvedCategoryId`, `CategoryImagePicker`, confirms, search/filters)
- `src/index.css` — removed obsolete admin-* rules; added shared option controls + new admin layout/library/nav styles; extended `.field` for textarea/errors
- `src/components/CategoryImagePicker.tsx` — `.field` + `.image-preview` instead of admin-only classes

---

## New flow (screenshot-level)

1. **Top:** “Admin” title + short description (like Settings).
2. **Left / top nav:** Five large section cards — Categories, Tasks, Rewards, Punishments, Users — with icon, name, and one-line hint. Active section is highlighted with accent border.
3. **Main area (one section):**
   - **List card:** Section title, count badge, search field, optional filter chips (e.g. category filter on Tasks), intro text where useful. Items are rounded rows (title + meta); selected row has accent border. Empty state is a dashed card with guidance.
   - **Form card below:** “New …” / “Edit …” with grouped blocks (Identity, Basics, Rules…), chips/radios for enums, primary **Create/Save** + ghost **Clear/Cancel**. Delete stays on list rows with `confirm()`.
4. **Bottom:** “Back to app” ghost button (full width).

**Users section:** Only the form card (no list) — same card/field pattern as Settings password block.

Build (`tsc --noEmit`) passes with no linter issues on the touched files.
